name: "grad-cultivation"
description: "Apply cultivation theory (Gerbner) to analyze how long-term media exposure shapes worldviews. Use this skill when the user needs to study cumulative media effects on audience beliefs, evaluate mainstreaming and resonance phenomena, or assess how media consumption patterns correlate with perceptions of social reality — even if they say 'does watching news make people more fearful', 'how does media shape worldview', or 'mean world syndrome'.".
